remarksWeb: Dear Sir/Madam,  Please note that we have added following number of shares in the data received from the RTA under the Public Category as mentioned below:  1. 5,000 Shares have been added to Non-Institution - Resident (nominal share capital up to 2 lakhs) towards allotment of shares pursuant to excercise of ESOPs by a resident employee; and  2. 54,403 Shares have been added to Non-Institution - Foreign Nationals towards allotment of shares pursuant to excercise of ESOPs by a non-resident employees.
